tagline: A beautiful web UI and PWA for pi — browse, read, and continue your AI coding sessions from any browser, on any device.

features.title: Resume from anywhere
features.details: Continue a session from your phone, tablet, or another computer. No SSH, no Termius — just open your browser.

features.title: Multi-session dashboard
features.details: Kick off work in one session while watching another stream. Search across projects, filter by branch, find what you need fast.

features.title: Open-source & model-agnostic
features.details: pi is fully open source and provider-agnostic. Pick any model, switch whenever you like — you're not locked to a vendor.

features.title: Safe remote access
features.details: Built-in token auth so you can expose it on your LAN or over Tailscale without worry.

features.title: Share your work
features.details: Export sessions as static snapshots or secret GitHub Gists in one click.

features.title: Your personal AI workspace
features.details: Install it like a native PWA and turn it into a personal assistant that lives on your machine.
